The ticket is **#88412**, and I've replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the barcode scan of the bill of lading. In the same thread Tobias confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, and a ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share. There are no Tansleigh files in the shared folders, so the channel post is the only record I could see. I didn't check whether the ticket is still open.
